audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose described Kassadin as an early-lane threat with 'engage range' language that fits an assassin with a level-3 gap-closer.
audit.why: Kassadin's Null Sphere is 650 range, Force Pulse only 400 and 21s at rank 1, and he has no mobility at all until level 6. The lane is a farm race he must survive, not a duel he can start.
audit.corrected: Tricky at 7/10 because of scaling, not early pressure: Hwei owns levels 1-5, and difficulty is entirely about the Riftwalk rank-3 window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart disagreed across layers and across itself: full-layer phases[0..4].side read 'Skill' while content win[0..4] read 'Hwei'; phases[5..6].side read 'Kassadin' while win[5..6] read 'Hwei' and their whys said Hwei favoured.
audit.why: Rows 0-4: Kassadin is mana-starved with 650 range and no mobility, so Hwei is favoured and the content layer was right. Rows 5-6: Riftwalk drops from 5s at rank 1 to 2s at rank 3 and Void Stone reduces magic damage, so the full layer was right and the content layer was stale.
audit.corrected: phases[0..4].side to Hwei (matching win[]); win[5] and win[6] to Kassadin (matching phases[5..6].side), with whys[5], whys[6], phases[5].why and phases[6].why rewritten to the new verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fabricated Hwei ability names ('Severalty (Q) zone', 'Devastating Fire Painting (E) poke'), Hwei credited with a 'stun', and none of the three real interactions in the kit were stated.
audit.why: Hwei's E subs are Grim Visage (fear), Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw — no stun. Riot's data flags Null Sphere as a channel-interrupter that also shields magic damage, and Nether Blade as an auto-attack reset.
audit.corrected: Null Sphere (9s, 650) interrupts channels and its shield absorbs magic — bait it before detonating the signature. Nether Blade's wind-up is the burst tell, not Riftwalk itself. Grim Visage (EQ) on his landing is the answer to a 500-range blink.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; the packet also flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'.
audit.why: Riftwalk 5/3.5/2, Force Pulse 21/20/19/18/17 and charge-gated, Null Sphere 9/8.5/8/7.5/7.
audit.corrected: Real numbers plus a wait-for-X-before-Y line written into the field and into dosFull.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content 'late' claimed Hwei stays in control into Kassadin's scaling window.
audit.why: Contradicts the full-layer chart and the kit: rank-3 Riftwalk plus Void Stone is the classic Kassadin flip.
audit.corrected: Late section rewritten to say the window closes and the win condition becomes ending before it.
